expr: (let allSubseq := (a.foldl fun acc x => acc ++ acc.map (fun sub => x :: sub)) [[]] |>.map List.reverse; let increasingSubseqLens := allSubseq.filter (fun l => List.Pairwise (· < ·) l) |>.map (·.length); increasingSubseqLens.foldl max (increasingSubseqLens.headD 0))

lemmas.name: LongestIncreasingSubsequence_ok
lemmas.statement: ∀ (a : Array Int) (h : LongestIncreasingSubsequence_precond a), LongestIncreasingSubsequence_postcond a (let allSubseq := (a.foldl fun acc x => acc ++ acc.map (fun sub => x :: sub)) [[]] |>.map List.reverse; let increasingSubseqLens := allSubseq.filter (fun l => List.Pairwise (· < ·) l) |>.map (·.length); increasingSubseqLens.foldl max (increasingSubseqLens.headD 0)) h
lemmas.proof:
by intro a h
  unfold LongestIncreasingSubsequence_postcond
  exact Refine.maxlist_int _ (List.ne_nil_of_mem (a := 0) (List.mem_map.mpr ⟨[], List.mem_filter.mpr ⟨List.mem_map.mpr ⟨[], Refine.allsub_nil_mem_arr a, rfl⟩, by simp⟩, rfl⟩))
